name: AuctionNet
description: Decision-making in large-scale games is an essential research area in artificial intelligence (AI) with significant real-world impact. However, the limited access to realistic large-scale game environments has hindered research progress in this area. In this paper, we present AuctionNet, a benchmark for bid decision-making in large-scale ad auctions derived from a real-world online advertising platform. AuctionNet is composed of three parts: an ad auction environment, a pre-generated dataset based on the environment, and performance evaluations of several baseline bid decision-making algorithms. reputation: A recent research benchmark for large-scale ad auction decision-making, with limited adoption so far beyond the original paper and related RL/ads research.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark based on a real-world advertising platform; results are environment- and policy-dependent, and community-wide SOTA numbers are not yet established.
